faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Assistant Professor posts at IIT Kanpur?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Assistant Professor positions at IIT Kanpur is 31st October 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum qualifications required for the Assistant Professor role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. with first-class or equivalent grades at the preceding degree, along with a very good academic record throughout their educational journey.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary structure for the Assistant Professor positions?
faq.answer: The salary is offered as per Pay Levels 10, 11, and 12, with basic pay ranging from Rs. 89,800 to Rs. 1,67,400, depending on the specific grade and experience.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any specific application fee for this recruitment drive. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any updates.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Assistant Professor positions at IIT Kanpur?
faq.answer: Applications need to be submitted online through the Pingala recruitment system on the official IIT Kanpur website before the closing date.

faq.question: Q6. What is the job type for these Assistant Professor positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these Assistant Professor positions is contract-based. However, for fresh PhD holders, the initial contract period is three years, with the possibility of regularization thereafter.

faq.question: Q7. Does IIT Kanpur offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Information regarding age relaxation for reserved categories is not explicitly detailed here. Candidates are encouraged to refer to the official notification for comprehensive details.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment drive is 2026-001.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates with industrial experience apply for this position?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates with three or more years of post-PhD teaching, research, or industrial experience may be considered for a regular appointment.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application link?
faq.answer: The official notification and application link can be found in the "Important Links" section of this article, providing direct access to the necessary resources.
